description:
Configure a dynamic shipping rate for the 'Domestic' zone in WooCommerce.

1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping.
2. Edit the existing 'Domestic' shipping zone.
3. Add a new 'Flat rate' shipping method.
4. Configure the new method with these details:
   - Method title: Volume Shipping
   - Cost: 10.00 + (2.50 * [qty])
     (This formula charges a $10 base fee plus $2.50 per item)
5. Save your changes.

The final shipping method must be enabled and calculate costs exactly as specified.
